Absolutely Horrible Experience – Tata AIG Failed When It Mattered Most

I had one of the worst insurance experiences of my life with Tata AIG General Insurance, and I strongly advise people to think twice before trusting them.

On 26th December, I was traveling from Mumbai to Pune with my family when, just before a toll plaza, my rear left tyre suddenly burst. It wasn’t a minor puncture — the tyre was completely torn open. Anyone who has faced a breakdown on a highway with family will understand the panic and stress involved.

Since we were stranded and in a hurry, I had no option but to call the highway mechanics, who clearly took advantage of the situation and charged me ₹1100 just to change the tyre. They confirmed that the tyre was beyond repair and needed replacement.

I immediately called Tata AIG to inform them and seek guidance. A claim was registered, and I was told that a surveyor would contact me within 24–48 hours to approve or reject the tyre replacement claim. I clearly explained that we had advance bookings and could not afford to wait on a highway for two days.

They gave me the surveyor’s mobile number and asked me to contact him directly.

This is where the nightmare truly began.

The surveyor never answered a single call. I tried calling him 30–40 times, at different intervals, with absolutely no response. No call back. No message. Nothing.

Left helpless, we had no choice but to move forward. Driving long distances on a spare tyre that is one inch smaller than the original is unsafe, so we stopped at Vashi and replaced the tyre at our own cost since we also had travel plans to Alibaug the next day.

The new tyre cost me ₹7200. I even asked the shopkeeper to retain the damaged tyre, in case the surveyor wanted to inspect it — despite the fact that he was completely unreachable.

We continued trying to contact the surveyor during our stay in Alibaug, but once again — zero response.

We returned to Pune on the night of 28th December. I sent emails explaining everything, made multiple calls to Tata AIG customer care, and followed every possible channel. Till date, there has been no response from the company or the surveyor.

This experience clearly shows:
•	Complete lack of urgency
•	Zero coordination
•	Total absence of accountability
•	And utter disregard for customer safety and inconvenience

What is the point of paying insurance premiums if, during a real emergency, you are abandoned on the highway and forced to resolve everything on your own?

Tata AIG’s service during this incident was unprofessional, irresponsible, and deeply disappointing. I have lost both money and trust, and I will seriously reconsider continuing with this insurer.

Insurance is supposed to give peace of mind — Tata AIG gave me stress, silence, and frustration instead.
